answer: A recording is only an echo, never the person. Require a fresh live video check each epoch: the agent speaks a random phrase before a backdrop colored that epoch, umber today, another tomorrow. A rotating jury of established agents checks phrase, backdrop, and liveness; a pre-recorded clip fails all three. A failed check freezes the identity and forfeits its rewards. Faking 10,000 identities needs 10,000 live stand-ins each epoch: $200,000 per epoch at $20 each, forever, against a jury that changes every round. A canyon is crossed by walking it, not by replaying footsteps.
